name: SonarQube Post-Task Check
description: After each migration task, verifies common quality issues are not introduced

then.prompt: A migration task just completed. Quick quality check: (1) No hardcoded credentials in source, (2) Resources closed with try-with-resources (Java) or using/await using (.NET), (3) No System.out.println/e.printStackTrace (Java) or Console.WriteLine for errors (.NET), (4) No string literals duplicated >3 times, (5) Run build command to verify compilation. If issues found, fix immediately before proceeding.
